The populist AfD secured a significant victory in eastern Germany, falling just short of an absolute majority. The win has drawn reactions from Elon Musk and Russia, raising concerns across Europe.

item.title: Russia and North Korea Open First Shared Border Bridge
item.description:
A new one-kilometre bridge spanning the Tumen River has opened between Russia and North Korea. This infrastructure project signals deepening ties between the two nations following the start of the war in Ukraine.

item.description:

item.title: Typhoon Saudel triggers mass evacuations in southeast China
item.description:
Torrential rain from Typhoon Saudel has caused widespread flooding, landslips, and infrastructure damage across several Chinese provinces. Hundreds of thousands have been evacuated as extreme weather impacts millions in the region.

item.title: Amazon cargo plane crash in Miami leaves five dead
item.description:
An Amazon cargo aircraft went off runway and caught fire in Miami. According to Flightradar24, the plane was traveling at nearly 130 mph before the accident. The incident resulted in five fatalities and several injuries.
